evidence_spans: For P↑, the Cr dimer remains AFM, with ∆E= 89.9 meV, substantially smaller than 308 meV obtained for the isolated dimer at the same Cr–Cr distance.
For P↑, the Cr dimer remains AFM, with ∆E= 89.9 meV

To establish a qualitative reference for the strength and distance dependence of the direct Cr–Cr exchange interaction, we first considered an isolated Cr dimer in vacuum, using the same exchange-correlation functional and Hubbard correction (U ef f= 4 eV) as the adsorbed systems.
CLM-MAT-0306.statement: The calculated magnetic energy difference ΔE for the adsorbed Cr dimer on the P↑ polarization state is 89.9 meV.

extra_quotes: We performed spin-polarized electronic structure calculations based on density functional theory (DFT), using the projector augmented wave method (PA W) as implemented in the Vienna Ab initio Simulation Package (V ASP) [13, 14].
As expected, this value is smaller than the experimental bandgap of approximately 1.3 eV, owing to the well-known band-gap underestimation within the PBE approximation [30].
